rows.label: Price vs. what holders paid

rows.label: Coins sitting in a profit
rows.plain: share of all supply currently above its cost

rows.label: 20-week heat
rows.plain: how far price is above (+) or below (−) its 20-week average — high = short-term overheated

rows.label: Traders' positioning
rows.plain: the annualised rate longs pay shorts — high + = crowd paying up to be long (greed / overheated)

rows.label: Supply in profit
rows.note: share of supply above its cost

rows.label: Supply held 90+ days
rows.note: share of all supply held longer than 90 days

rows.label: Supply held 155+ days
rows.note: share held longer than 155 days — the long-term-holder standard

rows.label: Supply held 1 year+
rows.note: share held longer than a year — the strongest hands

rows.label: Top-100 wallets' share
rows.note: share of holder supply held by the 100 biggest wallets — rising = consolidating

rows.label: Top-10 wallets' share
rows.note: the 10 biggest wallets' share of holder supply

rows.label: Gini coefficient
rows.note: 0 = supply spread perfectly evenly, 1 = all in one wallet

rows.label: Net flow onto exchanges
rows.note: organic net onto (+) minus off (−) exchanges over each window, one-time listing fills stripped · negative = leaving to self-custody (accumulation)

sections.title: Smart money
sections.note: A wallet qualifies only if it (1) put in real money — at least $25k of buys, (2) actually sold at a profit of 5× or more (proven timing, not paper gains), and (3) still holds at least 50k SPX today (still trackable). The set is recomputed every day: wallets that dump out drop off, freshly proven winners join. We publish only the total they hold and whether they're net buying or selling — never a wallet address.

rows.label: New qualifiers
rows.note: wallets newly proven by selling a top, counted over each window (headline = 90 days) — a spike = distribution starting

rows.label: Sellers' profit ratio (SOPR)
rows.note: coins that moved today sold for this multiple of their cost — above 1× = in profit

rows.label: Profit vs. loss cashed in
rows.note: dollar gains (+) minus losses (−) locked in on-chain today

rows.label: Coins waking up (liveliness)
rows.note: rising = long-dormant coins starting to move (distribution); falling = holders sitting tight
